posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT finally falls to 0-7 and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin has officially wandered longer than the Israelites with less to show for it.
posts.detail: A career 13-14-1 mark says BigBoiEmos is usually fine, but 0-7 with 731.92 points is a plague of its own making — remember, this is the same GM who drafted a defensive player first overall.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's fraud trial reaches a 9th straight guilty verdict and the 20-8 career record with the league's best 1.5 average finish is now unrecognizable.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra drops to 2-5 at 806.46 points — for a franchise with a .714 career win rate, this is starting to look less like a slump and more like the jig being up.

posts.headline: Forty straight editions and Thicks still hasn't given me a reason to stop calling Klint's Clipboard's ring a museum piece.
posts.detail: 5-2 is nice, but 839.22 points-for is pedestrian for a title holder, and a career 14-14 record says the crown has been coasting on fumes since it was won.

posts.headline: Sasinci claws back to 3-4 but Big Head's title defense is still gasping for air with a career 5.5 average finish that promised so much more.
posts.detail: 814.86 points and a losing record for a former champ means the Milk Man routine is funnier than the football right now — one ring doesn't buy forever patience.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh can't find a second win, parked at 1-6 with the league's worst 714.02 points matching a career 12 average finish to the decimal.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career record and now this — the name was never a joke, it's a prophecy that keeps coming true one Sunday at a time.
